profile_text.body:
Ambarella describes itself as a provider of AI vision processors for edge applications. Its website says its advanced imaging solutions make cameras smarter by extracting valuable data from high-resolution video streams. The company lists advanced driver assistance systems, smart electronic mirrors, drive recorders, and autonomous vehicles among the areas it addresses.

The company's AI position centers on edge vision processing, with no specific product names given in the available material.

The held facts identify Ambarella as a for-profit public company headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with ticker AMBA and CIK 0001280263. They also list 281 California law exposure entries.
